response.sql: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS amount_spent FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), customer_shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, amount_spent, 1.0 * amount_spent / SUM(amount_spent) OVER () AS revenue_share FROM customer_totals), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(revenue_share) AS value FROM customer_shares) SELECT AVG(cs.amount_spent) AS average_amount_spent, AVG(cs.revenue_share) AS average_share, AVG(cs.revenue_share - a.value) AS average_share_above_average FROM customer_shares cs CROSS JOIN average_share a WHERE cs.revenue_share > a.value;
